- Request a second breath sample if the first seems inconsistent, and note the time between tests.
- Request a confirmatory test: a properly collected blood test is generally considered more direct for BAC.
- Document everything: times, what you consumed, medications, medical conditions (GERD/diabetes), and any deviations from procedure.

4) If you’re trying to ensure you pass safely
- The only reliable method is time: your body metabolizes alcohol gradually (commonly around 0.01–0.02 BAC per hour, varying by person).
